page.overview:
What is Three-Section Staff?

The three-section staff is a Chinese flail weapon that consists of three wooden or metal staffs connected by metal rings or rope.

The Edenian warrior Tanya now utilizes a three-section staff in her appearance in Mortal Kombat 1, replacing her tonfas and the Naginata from her appearance in Mortal Kombat X.
